items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: for instance, this lady, Terri Lyne Carrington.

ctx.x: So, that’s it. That’s what I… I’m into now. I’m always being into. Even… but now, I try to say this as much with fewer notes. Is it Miles who said, “Less is more”? Something like that. And okay, just listen. Keep listen. Keep listening. I listen to… for instance, this lady, Terri Lyne Carrington. Isn’t she [mean?] [inaudible]. I think she’s mean, you know.
